name: Anthropic Skills
summary: Public Agent Skills repository: document skills for docx, pdf, pptx and xlsx, example skills, a template and the Agent Skills spec.
description: Skills are folders of instructions, scripts and resources that Claude loads dynamically to handle specialised tasks. This repository holds Anthropic's implementation: document skills for creating and editing docx, pdf, pptx and xlsx files, example skills, a skill template and the Agent Skills specification, with usage paths for Claude Code, Claude.ai and the Claude API.
